mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_PROJ_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_PROJECT ( PROJ_ID, CHTRM_ID, PROJ_NM, PROJ_CN, PROJ_BGNG_YMD, PROJ_END_YMD, PROJ_STAT_CD, PROJ_CREAT_DT, PROJ_LDR_EMP_ID ) VALUES ( #{projId}, #{chtrmId}, #{projNm}, #{projCn}, #{projBgngYmd}, #{projEndYmd}, '01', SYSDATE, #{projLdrEmpId} )
mapper.select: SELECT P.PROJ_ID, P.PROJ_NM, P.PROJ_BGNG_YMD, P.PROJ_END_YMD, CASE WHEN P.PROJ_STAT_CD = '01' AND P.PROJ_BGNG_YMD <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '02' ELSE P.PROJ_STAT_CD END AS PROJ_STAT_CD, E.EMP_NM AS PROJ_LDR_NM FROM TB_PROJECT P JOIN TB_PROJ_MEMBER PM ON PM.PROJ_ID = P.PROJ_ID AND PM.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND PM.LEAVE_DT IS NULL JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = P.PROJ_LDR_EMP_ID ORDER BY P.PROJ_CREAT_DT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PROJECT SET PROJ_STAT_CD = '02', PROJ_STAT_CHG_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PROJ_STAT_CD = '01' AND TRUNC(PROJ_BGNG_YMD) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
